metadata.title: 65 Years Legacy of Chicken Inn | Butter Chicken + Mutton Burra + Chicken Bharta + Best Breads
metadata.description:
This episode marks 65 years of Chicken Inn, a restaurant that has stood the test of time and continues to be a reference point for classic North Indian dining.

It traces the legacy of Chicken Inn, revisiting its early years, its rise as a trusted name, and the many changes it has witnessed while remaining rooted in its original ethos. Over the decades, Chicken Inn has served generations of diners, becoming part of countless family meals, celebrations, and everyday rituals of the city.

Aman, who carries this legacy forward today, reflects on the journey of the restaurant and the responsibility of preserving its identity in a changing food landscape.

We take you into the kitchen to show the preparation of signature dishes such as Chicken Bharta, Butter Chicken, Mutton Burra, Brain Masala, Naan, along with a wide and well-established range of vegetarian dishes that have long been part of the menu.

Through stories, kitchen processes, and moments from service, the episode offers audiences a comprehensive look at what has shaped Chicken Inn over 65 years, its food, its consistency, and the legacy it continues to build.
